    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    BuyHouseDialog
    BuyHouseDialog is a modal dialog that allows players to purchase houses for their monopolies in the Monopoly game.
    Card
    The Card class serves as an abstract representation of a card in the Monopoly game, providing a framework for specific card types such as Chance and Community Chest cards.
    CardCell
    The CardCell class represents a cell on the Monopoly game board that is associated with a card type, such as Chance or Community Chest.
    CardsTest
    CardsTest is a test class that extends TestCase to verify the functionality of card types in a Monopoly game.
    CCCellInfoFormatter
    CCCellInfoFormatter is a class that implements the CellInfoFormatter interface to format information for CCCell objects in a Monopoly game.
    Cell
    This abstract class represents a cell on the Monopoly board.
    CellInfoFormatter
    CellInfoFormatter is an interface that defines a method for formatting information about a Cell object in a Monopoly game.
    CellInfoFormatterTest
    CellInfoFormatterTest is a test class that verifies the functionality of the InfoFormatter and its associated cell formatters, including GoCellInfoFormatter and PropertyCell formatting.
    ChanceCellInfoFormatter
    ChanceCellInfoFormatter is a class that implements the CellInfoFormatter interface to format information for ChanceCell objects in a Monopoly game.
    Die
    The Die class represents a standard six-sided die used in the Monopoly game.
    FreeParkingCell
    The FreeParkingCell class represents the "Free Parking" cell in a Monopoly game.
    FreeParkingCellInfoFormatter
    FreeParkingCellInfoFormatter is a class that implements the CellInfoFormatter interface to format information for Free Parking cells in a Monopoly game.
    GainMoneyCardTest
    GainMoneyCardTest is a test class that extends TestCase to test the functionality of the MoneyCard class, specifically for cards that grant players money.
    GameBoard
    Represents the game board for a Monopoly game, containing cells, property information, and card decks.
    GameBoard14
    GameBoard14 is a subclass of GameBoard that initializes a Monopoly game board with a specific configuration of 14 property cells, each with predefined names, color groups, prices, rents, and house prices.
    GameBoardCCGainMoney
    GameBoardCCGainMoney is a subclass of GameBoard that initializes a Monopoly game board with two blue properties, a community chest cell, a jail cell, and a chance card cell.
    GameBoardCCJail
    GameBoardCCJail is a subclass of GameBoard that initializes a Monopoly game board with two blue properties, a community chest cell, a jail cell, and a chance card cell.
    GameBoardCCLoseMoney
    GameBoardCCLoseMoney is a subclass of GameBoard that initializes a Monopoly game board with specific cells and cards configured to include Community Chest and Chance cards that cause players to lose money.
    GameBoardCCMovePlayer
    GameBoardCCMovePlayer is a subclass of GameBoard that initializes a Monopoly game board with two blue properties, a community chest cell, a jail cell, and a chance card cell.
    GameboardCreationTest
    GameboardCreationTest is a test class that extends TestCase to verify the correct creation and layout of the Monopoly game board.
    GameBoardFreeParking
    GameBoardFreeParking is a subclass of GameBoard that initializes a Monopoly game board with a specific configuration of cells, including Jail, Free Parking, and Go To Jail cells.
    GameBoardFull
    GameBoardFull is a subclass of GameBoard that initializes a complete Monopoly game board with all properties, railroads, utilities, special cells, and card decks.
    GameBoardJail
    GameBoardJail is a subclass of GameBoard that initializes a Monopoly game board with a specific configuration of cells, including properties, jail, and go-to-jail cells.
    GameBoardRailRoad
    GameBoardRailRoad is a subclass of GameBoard that initializes a Monopoly game board with a specific configuration of cells, including properties, railroads, and special cells like Jail and Free Parking.
    GameboardTest
    GameboardTest is a test class for the GameBoard class in the Monopoly game.
    GameBoardUtil
    GameBoardUtil is a utility class that provides methods for calculating the dimensions of a Monopoly game board and retrieving cells from specific sides (east, north, south, west) of the board.
    GameBoardUtility
    GameBoardUtility is a subclass of GameBoard that initializes a Monopoly game board with a specific configuration of cells, including properties, utilities, railroads, and special cells like Jail and Free Parking.
    GameMaster
    GameMaster is a singleton class that manages the state and flow of the Monopoly game.
    GameMasterTest
    Test class for the GameMaster class in the Monopoly game.
    GoCell
    Represents the 'Go' cell in the Monopoly game.
    GoCellInfoFormatter
    GoCellInfoFormatter is a class that implements the CellInfoFormatter interface to format information for GoCell objects in a Monopoly game.
    GoToJailCardTest
    GoToJailCardTest is a test class that verifies the behavior of the JailCard in the Monopoly game.
    GoToJailCell
    Represents the "Go to Jail" cell in the Monopoly game.
    GotoJailCellInfoFormatter
    GotoJailCellInfoFormatter is a class that implements the CellInfoFormatter interface to format information for GotoJailCell objects in a Monopoly game.
    GUICell
    GUICell is a JPanel that represents a cell on the Monopoly game board in the GUI.
    GUIRespondDialog
    GUIRespondDialog is a modal dialog that prompts the user for a Yes or No response regarding a trade deal in the Monopoly game.
    GUITradeDialog
    GUITradeDialog is a modal dialog that allows players to trade properties in the Monopoly game.
    InfoFormatter
    The InfoFormatter class provides a centralized mechanism to format information for different types of Monopoly game cells.
    InfoPanel
    InfoPanel is a JPanel that displays information about all players in the Monopoly game.
    JailCard
    Represents a card in the Monopoly game that sends a player directly to jail.
    JailCell
    Represents the Jail cell in the Monopoly game.
    JailCellInfoFormatter
    JailCellInfoFormatter is a class that implements the CellInfoFormatter interface to format information for JailCell objects in a Monopoly game.
    LoseMoneyCardTest
    LoseMoneyCardTest is a test class for the MoneyCard functionality in the Monopoly game.
    Main
    The Main class serves as the entry point for the Monopoly game application.
    MainWindow
    MainWindow is the primary JFrame for the Monopoly game GUI, responsible for displaying the game board, player information, and handling user interactions.
    MockGUI
    MockGUI is a mock implementation of the MonopolyGUI interface for testing purposes.
    MockRespondDialog
    MockRespondDialog is a mock implementation of the RespondDialog interface for testing purposes.
    MockTradeDialog
    MockTradeDialog is a mock implementation of the TradeDialog interface for testing purposes.
    MoneyCard
    Represents a card in the Monopoly game that adjusts a player's money by a specified amount.
    MonopolyGUI
    MonopolyGUI is an interface that defines the methods required for the graphical user interface of a Monopoly game.
    MovePlayerCard
    Represents a card in the Monopoly game that moves a player to a specified destination cell.
    MovePlayerCardTest
    MovePlayerCardTest is a test class for the MovePlayerCard functionality in the Monopoly game.
    Player
    Represents a player in the Monopoly game, managing their properties, money, position, and jail status.
    PlayerPanel
    PlayerPanel is a JPanel that displays information about a specific player in the Monopoly game.
    PlayerTest
     
    PropertyCell
    Represents a purhcasable property cell on the Monopoly board.
    PropertyCellInfoFormatter
    The PropertyCellInfoFormatter class implements the CellInfoFormatter interface to provide a formatted string representation of a PropertyCell's information.
    PropertyCellTest
     
    RailRoadCell
    Represents a railroad cell on the Monopoly board.
    RailRoadCellTest
     
    RespondDialog
    RespondDialog is an interface that defines a method for obtaining a response from a dialog.
    RRCellInfoFormatter
    RRCellInfoFormatter is a class that implements the CellInfoFormatter interface to format information for RailRoadCell objects in a Monopoly game.
    SimpleGameBoard
    Represents a simple game board for a Monopoly game, containing a predefined set of property cells.
    TestDiceRollDialog
    TestDiceRollDialog is a modal dialog that allows users to input a dice roll amount for testing purposes in a Monopoly game.
    TradeDeal
    Represents a trade deal between two players in the Monopoly game.
    TradeDealTest
     
    TradeDialog
    This interface defines the contract for a trade dialog in the Monopoly game.
    UtilCellInfoFormatter
    The UtilCellInfoFormatter class implements the CellInfoFormatter interface to provide a formatted string representation of a UtilityCell's information.
    UtilDiceRoll
    UtilDiceRoll is a modal dialog that allows players to roll dice in a Monopoly game.
    UtilityCell
     
    UtilityCellTest
